name: Quill Forms Open-Source Form Builder
free_limit: LGPL-3.0 open-source React/TypeScript conversational form renderer and WordPress plugin; self-managed installation has no published vendor-imposed software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires your own React/Next.js application or WordPress hosting and maintenance. Hosted Quill Forms Studio and premium add-ons are separate offerings; no free hosted submission, storage or traffic quota is claimed. Verify feature-specific licenses before adopting paid extensions.
